description: Grid mode (C1) in 3D: 1×2 layout; both panels show 3D point cloud with linked cameras; ≥5% pixel coverage in each panel.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
n = 2000
k = rng.integers(0, 3, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (3, 20))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 20)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(20)])
df['cluster'] = [f'grp_{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, n)

steps.name: switch to 3D and wait for layout
enable 1×2 grid in 3D
steps.report: { enabled: a.grid.enabled, layout: a.grid.layout, dims: a.dims }

steps.name: set panel 1 to color by score
steps.eval: const scoreCol = a.describe.columns.find(c => c.name === 'score'); a.setPanelColorColumn(1, scoreCol.index)

steps.name: both panels have ≥5% non-background pixels in 3D (points rendered in every panel)
steps.eval: await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); const img = new Image(); await new Promise(r => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = img.width; cv.height = img.height; cv.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); const W = cv.width, H = cv.height, ctx = cv.getContext('2d'); const topBand=76, panelW=Math.floor(W/2), panelH=H-topBand; function panelBright(x0,y0,w,h){ const d=ctx.getImageData(x0,y0,w,h).data; let n=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4) if(d[i]+d[i+1]+d[i+2]>60) n++; return n; } window.__3dPanelPx = [panelBright(0,topBand,panelW,panelH), panelBright(panelW,topBand,W-panelW,panelH)]; window.__3dThreshold = Math.floor(0.02 * panelW * panelH)
steps.report: { panel0: window.__3dPanelPx[0], panel1: window.__3dPanelPx[1], threshold: window.__3dThreshold }

steps.name: linked cameras in 3D: all panels project the same relative position for a world point
steps.eval: const ax = a.anchorXY[0], ay = a.anchorXY[1]; const vps = a.renderer.deck.getViewports(); window.__3dLinkPos = vps.map(vp => ({ id: vp.id, relX: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[0].toFixed(2)), relY: parseFloat(vp.project([ax, ay])[1].toFixed(2)) }))
